theorem PV_DIAG8.DIAG8_inputs_given_native_binding : ∀ {P W O : Type} (native : P → W → PV_DIAG8.DIAG8Inputs)
  (decode : PV_DIAG8.DIAG8Inputs → O) (messages : P → List PV_DIAG8.ClientGuard) (path : P → List PV_DIAG8.PathStep)
  (stack : P → List ℕ) (requests : P → List PV_DIAG8.Request)
  (world : PV_DIAG8.History → PV_DIAG8.Request → PV_DIAG8.Reply),
  (∀ (p : P) (w : W), native p w = PV_DIAG8.publicInputs messages path stack requests world p) →
    ∀ (p : P) (w w' : W), decode (native p w) = decode (native p w') :=
fun {P W O} native decode messages path stack requests world sourceBinding p w w' =>
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => decode _a = decode (native p w')) (sourceBinding p w)))
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => decode (PV_DIAG8.publicInputs messages path stack requests world p) = decode _a)
          (sourceBinding p w')))
      (Eq.refl (decode (PV_DIAG8.publicInputs messages path stack requests world p))))
theorem PV_DIAG8.DIAG8_prefix_family : ∀ {P W O : Type} (native : P → W → ℕ → PV_DIAG8.DIAG8Inputs)
  (decode : PV_DIAG8.DIAG8Inputs → O) (publicFamily : P → ℕ → PV_DIAG8.DIAG8Inputs),
  (∀ (p : P) (w : W) (n : ℕ), native p w n = publicFamily p n) →
    ∀ (p : P) (w w' : W), (fun n => decode (native p w n)) = fun n => decode (native p w' n) :=
fun {P W O} native decode publicFamily sourceBinding p w w' =>
  funext fun n =>
    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => decode _a = decode (native p w' n)) (sourceBinding p w n)))
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => decode (publicFamily p n) = decode _a) (sourceBinding p w' n)))
        (Eq.refl (decode (publicFamily p n))))
